segments.title: Lethal Company Gaming Broadcast
segments.notes: Case Blackwell hosts an extended Lethal Company session with a rotating lobby of streamer friends using the Bigger Lobby mod; multiple planetary runs culminate in quota clearance before a raid handoff.

lore_notes.fact: Claims to be canonically embedded in Fortnite lore.
Announces a 'dream stream at noon' the following day, noting it will be remote.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell departs the news desk for a three-hour Lethal Company marathon, wrangling a oversized lobby of streamer friends through repeated mod installs, planetary expeditions, and chaotic quota runs. After multiple wipes and a final successful haul, Case exits the session and raids Gina's channel.
